items.title: A sheaf glued from open algebraic subfunctors is an algebraic space
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file spaces.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: an fppf sheaf F on (Sch/S)_{fppf} covered by subfunctors F_i that are algebraic spaces with representable open immersions F_i -> F, whose disjoint union is again an algebraic space and maps surjectively onto F, is an algebraic space (source lines 1298-1318). The proof shows first that the F_i form a Zariski covering, then that the diagonal is representable by reducing to the representable G_i = G x_F F_i and gluing along that Zariski covering, and finally exhibits a surjective etale U = coproduct U_i -> F, checking etaleness after base change to a scheme.
